verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it can be deployed 'entirely within your own infrastructure' (qodo-docs-16). They also provide a dedicated self-managed/on-prem deployment guide (qodo-docs-39) and a deployment-model table listing single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped options per Git provider (qodo-docs-40). Missing for 10: detailed evidence of what the self-hosted install involves (components, requirements, feature parity with the SaaS), clarity on which Git providers support on-prem, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment.
